001.title: [FUNC] Verify when the category is no category, the DNS Reply is forwarded by DUT, and log shows..
001.result: 1.In step 5, the DNS reply from Neustar is forwarded to the Client by DUT./n 2.In step 6, a log displayed: DNS Filtering - DNS Packet Allowed.

002.title: [FUNC] Verify when the category action is Allow, the DNS Reply is forwarded by DUT, and log shows..
002.result: In step 5-8, the DNS reply from Neustar is forwarded to the Client by DUT, and a log displayed: DNS Filtering - DNS Packet Allowed.

003.title: [FUNC] Verify when the category action is Block, the DNS Reply is dropped by DUT, and log shows.
003.result: In step 5-9, DNS Reply is dropped by DUT, and a log displayed: DNS Filtering - DNS Packet Blocked..

004.title: [FUNC] Verify when the category action is Negative Reply, the flag is changed and the changed Reply is forwarded by DUT, and log shows.
004.result: In step 5-9, the flag in DNS Reply, which is forwarded to the Client by DUT, is 0010(Server failure), and a log displayed: DNS Filtering - DNS Packet Negatively Replied..

005.title: [FUNC] Verify when the category action is Forged IP Reply, the answer address is changed and the changed Reply is forwarded by DUT, and log shows.
005.result:
1.In step 5-7, the answer address in DNS Reply, which is forwarded to the Client by DUT, is 127.0.0.2 and a log displayed: DNS Filtering - DNS Packet IP Forged;
 2.In step 8-9, the answer address in DNS Reply, which is forwarded to the Client by DUT, is 1001::2 and a log displayed: DNS Filtering - DNS Packet IP Forged.
